import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from ref import Topo
import importlib.util
spec_=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('mp','/workspace/submission/main.py')
M=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec_); spec_.loader.exec_module(M)

BIN='/workspace/tmp/unit-merge-build/engine'

def legal(spec, rng, d, g, quota=1, budget=10**12, weight=1, pinmod=0, same_cls=True):
    topo=Topo(spec); n=topo.n; T=len(topo.foots)
    by_dom={}
    for tid,dm in enumerate(topo.domains): by_dom.setdefault(dm,[]).append(tid)
    doms=sorted(by_dom)
    gkey=[(doms[(i*7)%(len(doms) if same_cls else len(doms))], i%4) for i in range(g)]
    tasks=[]
    for i in range(d):
        gid=i%g
        dom,cls=gkey[gid]
        tasks.append([by_dom[dom][i % len(by_dom[dom])], gid, weight, cls, 1 if (pinmod and i%pinmod==0) else 0])
    fp=[set() for _ in range(g)]
    for t in tasks: fp[t[1]]|=set(topo.foots[t[0]])
    caps=[0]*n
    for gid in range(g):
        if fp[gid]:
            for x in fp[gid]: caps[x]+=quota
    return topo, {'topology':spec,'caps':caps,'groups':[[quota,budget] for _ in range(g)],
                  'tasks':tasks,'query':{'groups':list(range(min(g,4))),'nodes':[],'tasks':[]},
                  'transactions':[]}

def engine_time(request, label):
    data = M.transport(request)
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([BIN], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    el=time.time()-t0
    print('%-26s engine %6.2fs out=%d rc=%d head=%s' % (label, el, len(p.stdout), p.returncode, p.stdout[:60]))
    return el
